title: Astricon 2023
html:
This year the Astricon, the conference organised by the developers of Asterisk PBX, is colocated with ITExpo East during February 14-16, 2023, in Fort Lauderdale area, FL, USA. More details about event are available at:

  • https://www.itexpo.com/east/astricon.aspx

From Kamailio project, you can meet there Fred Posner, who will have a presentation about “Security, High Availability Scaling”. Do not miss the chance to talk with him if you go to the event!

Also, do not forget that next Kamailio World Conference is scheduled to take place in Berlin, Germany, during June 5-7, 2023, returning as an in-person event! See more details about it at:

  • https://www.kamailioworld.com/k2023/

Looking forward to meeting many of you in Berlin!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
